description: Internet lines, throughput, latency and the health of the UniFi gateway (UDM, UCG, USG, UXG). Internet traffic comes from UniFi's WAN rate and the gateway's per-port counters.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the gateway last started.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Gateway CPU use now. Orange above 70%, red above 90%.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Gateway memory use now. Orange above 80%, red above 90%. A slow climb over days is worth watching; it usually resets after a firmware update or restart.

panels.title: CPU temperature
panels.description: Hottest CPU sensor. Orange above 75 °C, red above 85 °C.

panels.title: Internet latency
panels.description: UniFi's latency check to the internet, now. Orange above 100 ms, red above 200 ms.

panels.title: Clients online
panels.description: Devices connected to the site now, wired and wireless.

panels.title: Internet lines
panels.description: Each internet line (WAN). State is UniFi's view now: Active carries traffic, Backup waits for a failover. Up is UniFi's availability figure for the line (standby lines have none). Speed test columns show the most recent test UniFi ran on that line.

panels.title: Internet throughput
panels.description: Download above the line, upload below it, across all internet lines. From UniFi's WAN rate, which is reliable on UniFi OS gateways where the WAN byte counters are not.

panels.title: Traffic by internet line
panels.description: Download per internet line, from the gateway port each line is plugged into. Shows which line is carrying traffic and when a failover moved it. Needs the gateway ports to have the same names as the internet lines; if this panel is empty, see Traffic by port under Ports.

targets.expr: sum by (port_name) (rate(unpoller_device_port_receive_bytes_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$Gateway"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8 and on (port_name) label_replace(max by (wan_interface) (unpoller_wan_interface_state{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"}), "port_name", "$1", "wan_interface", "(.*)")

panels.title: Internet latency
panels.description: UniFi's latency check to the internet. Dashed line at 100 ms; above it, calls and video start to suffer.

panels.title: CPU and memory
panels.description: Share of CPU and memory in use.

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: Each temperature sensor in the gateway: CPU, board, storage.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Processes waiting for CPU, averaged over 1, 5 and 15 minutes.

panels.title: LAN throughput
panels.description: Traffic between the gateway and your local networks. Received above the line, sent below it.

panels.title: Ports
panels.description: Every gateway port with its link speed and current traffic.

panels.title: Traffic by port
panels.description: Received traffic per port.

panels.title: Port errors and drops
panels.description: Packets dropped or received with errors, per port. Should stay at zero; a steady rate points to a bad cable, fibre or module.

targets.expr: sum by (port_name) (rate(unpoller_device_port_receive_errors_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$Gateway"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(unpoller_device_port_transmit_errors_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$Gateway"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(unpoller_device_port_receive_dropped_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$Gateway"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(unpoller_device_port_transmit_dropped_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$Gateway"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Fibre module signal
panels.description: Optical power the SFP modules receive and send, in dBm. A falling receive level means a dirty or damaged fibre, or a problem at the provider's end.

panels.title: Fibre module temperature
panels.description: Temperature of each SFP module. Most are rated to 70–85 °C.

panels.title: Gateway details
panels.description: Model, firmware and addresses.

targets.expr: max by (name, model, version, ip, mac, serial) (unpoller_device_info{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$Gateway"})

title: UniFi Gateway
